about.bio: Systems Engineer and Full Stack Developer dedicated to architecting reliable software, conducting scientific research, and training the next generation of engineers. With a passion for academic rigor and real-world efficiency, I bridge the gap between complex system design and intuitive web experiences.
about.philosophy: I believe in building software that is maintainable, robust, and accessible. Whether designing databases or lecturing on algorithms, my focus is always on solving structural problems rather than applying superficial fixes.
